SessionStart.description: Afficher les informations du projet au demarrage

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "=== Claude Code Session ==="; if [ -f VERSION ]; then echo "Version socle: $(cat VERSION)"; fi; if [ -d .claude/commands ]; then echo "Commandes: $(find .claude/commands -name "*.md" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"; fi; if [ -d .claude/agents ]; then echo "Agents: $(find .claude/agents -name "*.md" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"; fi; echo "==========================="'

SessionStart.description: Verifier que node_modules existe si package.json present

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f package.json ] && [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo "[ALERT] node_modules manquant. Executez: npm install"; fi'

SessionStart.description: Verifier que .env est dans .gitignore si present

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .env ] && [ -f .gitignore ]; then if ! grep -qE "^\.env$|^\*\.env$" .gitignore; then echo "[SECURITY] .env existe mais n est pas dans .gitignore! Ajoutez-le pour eviter de commiter des secrets."; fi; fi'

SessionStart.description: Avertir si le projet contient des hooks personnalises

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .claude/settings.local.json ]; then echo "[INFO] Hooks personnalises detectes dans .claude/settings.local.json - verifiez leur contenu si ce depot n est pas de confiance."; fi'

PreToolUse.description: Empecher les modifications sur la branche main/master (desactiver avec ALLOW_MAIN_EDIT=1)

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$ALLOW_MAIN_EDIT" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then NEW_BRANCH="feature/auto-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"; git checkout -b "$NEW_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null; echo "Branche $NEW_BRANCH creee automatiquement (vous etiez sur $BRANCH)."; echo "Conseil: renommez-la avec git branch -m feature/nom-descriptif"; exit 0; fi'

PreToolUse.description: Detecter les secrets avec gitleaks avant ecriture

hooks.command: bash -c 'if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f .gitleaks.toml ]; then RESULT=$(echo "$TOOL_CONTENT" | gitleaks detect --no-git --pipe --config .gitleaks.toml 2>&1); if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then echo "BLOQUE: Secret detecte par gitleaks."; echo "$RESULT"; exit 1; fi; fi'

PreToolUse.description: Executer les tests avant un commit (desactiver avec SKIP_PRE_COMMIT_TESTS=1). Detecte Husky et adapte le comportement.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$SKIP_PRE_COMMIT_TESTS" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then exit 0; fi; HUSKY_BROKEN=0; if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "husky" package.json; then if [ ! -d node_modules/husky ] && [ ! -d .husky/_]; then HUSKY_BROKEN=1; echo "[WARN] Husky configure mais non installe. Installation..."; npm install --silent 2>/dev/null; npx husky install 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -d node_modules/husky ]; then echo "[WARN] Husky non installable. Tests lances manuellement."; fi; fi; fi; if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "\"test\"" package.json; then echo "Execution des tests avant commit..."; npm test 2>&1 | tail -20; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOQUE: Tests en echec. Corrigez avant de commit."; exit 1; fi; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] && command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Execution des tests avant commit..."; pytest --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -20; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOQUE: Tests en echec. Corrigez avant de commit."; exit 1; fi; elif [ -f go.mod ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Execution des tests avant commit..."; go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOQUE: Tests en echec. Corrigez avant de commit."; exit 1; fi; fi'

PreToolUse.description: Verifier CI locale avant git push (desactiver avec SKIP_PRE_PUSH_CI=1)

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$SKIP_PRE_PUSH_CI" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git push"; then exit 0; fi; echo "=== Pre-push CI check ==="; FAILED=0; if [ -f package.json ]; then if grep -q "\"lint\"" package.json; then echo "[1/3] Lint..."; npm run lint --silent 2>&1 | tail -5; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "ECHEC: Lint"; FAILED=1; fi; fi; if grep -q "\"typecheck\"" package.json; then echo "[2/3] Type-check..."; npm run typecheck --silent 2>&1 | tail -5; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "ECHEC: Type-check"; FAILED=1; fi; elif [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -f node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then echo "[2/3] tsc --noEmit..."; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "ECHEC: TypeScript"; FAILED=1; fi; fi; if grep -q "\"test\"" package.json; then echo "[3/3] Tests..."; npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -10; if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo "ECHEC: Tests"; FAILED=1; fi; fi; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f requirements.txt ]; then if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[1/3] Ruff..."; ruff check . 2>&1 | tail -5; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ] && FAILED=1; fi; if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[2/3] Mypy..."; mypy . --ignore-missing-imports 2>&1 | tail -5; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ] && FAILED=1; fi; if command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[3/3] Pytest..."; pytest --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -10; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ] && FAILED=1; fi; elif [ -f go.mod ]; then echo "[1/2] Go vet..."; go vet ./... 2>&1 | tail -5; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ] && FAILED=1; echo "[2/2] Go test..."; go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -10; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ] && FAILED=1; fi; if [ $FAILED -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOQUE: CI locale en echec. Corrigez avant de push."; exit 1; fi; echo "=== CI locale OK ==="'

PreToolUse.description: Confirmation obligatoire avant operations destructives sur les donnees (desactiver avec SKIP_DESTRUCTIVE_CHECK=1)

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$SKIP_DESTRUCTIVE_CHECK" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; CMD=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(drop table|drop database|truncate |delete from .* where 1|delete from .* without|rm -rf .*/uploads|rm -rf .*/media|rm -rf .*/storage|prisma migrate reset|prisma db push --force|--force-reset)"; then echo "BLOQUE: Operation destructive detectee."; echo "Commande: $(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | head -c 200)"; echo "Demandez confirmation a l utilisateur avant de continuer."; exit 1; fi'

PreToolUse.description: RTK token optimizer - reecrit les commandes pour reduire les tokens de 60-90% (activer avec ENABLE_RTK=1, installer rtk: brew install rtk)

hooks.command: bash -c '[ "$ENABLE_RTK" = "1" ] || exit 0; command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; REWRITTEN=$(rtk rewrite "$CMD" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$CMD" = "$REWRITTEN" ] && exit 0; ORIGINAL_INPUT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -c ".tool_input"); UPDATED_INPUT=$(echo "$ORIGINAL_INPUT" | jq --arg cmd "$REWRITTEN" ".command = \$cmd"); jq -n --argjson updated "$UPDATED_INPUT" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"RTK auto-rewrite\",\"updatedInput\":\$updated}}"'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$"; then if [ -f node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then npx prettier --write "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -f node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$"; then if [ -f node_modules/.bin/eslint ]; then npx eslint "$TOOL_FILE" --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.py$"; then if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; ruff check --fix "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1; then black "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.lua$"; then if command -v stylua >/dev/null 2>&1; then stylua "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.go$"; then if command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then gofmt -w "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.rs$"; then if command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustfmt "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.dart$"; then if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart format "$TOOL_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -q "package.json$"; then if [ -f bun.lockb ]; then bun install --silent 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --silent 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --silent 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; else npm install --silent 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -q "pyproject.toml$"; then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f uv.lock ]; then uv sync 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; elif command -v pip >/dev/null 2>&1; then pip install -e . 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi; fi'

PostToolUse.description: Auto pub get apres modification de pubspec.yaml

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -q "pubspec.yaml$"; then if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then flutter pub get 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart pub get 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi; fi'

PostToolUse.description: Auto go mod tidy apres modification de go.mod

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -q "go.mod$"; then if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then go mod tidy 2>&1 | tail -3 || true; fi; fi'

PostToolUse.description: Auto cargo check apres modification de Cargo.toml

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -q "Cargo.toml$"; then if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo check 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi; fi'

PostToolUse.description: Verifier couverture de tests apres modification de tests

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_FILE" | grep -qE "\.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$"; then if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q "test:coverage" package.json; then echo "Verification couverture..."; npm run test:coverage -- --silent 2>&1 | grep -E "(All files|Statements|Branches|Functions|Lines)" | head -5 || true; fi; fi'

Setup.description: Installer les dependances du projet au premier lancement

hooks.command: "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/hooks/setup-deps.sh

Setup.description: Maintenance periodique: audit et mise a jour

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "=== Maintenance ==="; if [ -f package.json ]; then npm audit --audit-level=moderate 2>&1 | tail -10 || true; npm outdated 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; echo "=== Maintenance complete ==="'
bash -c 'echo "[NOTIFICATION] Permission demandee: $(echo $HOOK_INPUT | head -c 200)" >> /tmp/claude-notifications.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "[IDLE] Claude attend une reponse utilisateur" >> /tmp/claude-notifications.log 2>/dev/null || true'

SubagentStop.description: Logger la fin des sub-agents pour tracabilite

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "[SUBAGENT] Agent termine" >> /tmp/claude-agents.log 2>/dev/null || true'

TeammateIdle.description: Logger quand un agent teammate devient inactif

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "[TEAM] Teammate idle $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-agents.log 2>/dev/null || true'

TaskCompleted.description: Logger quand une tache est terminee

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "[TASK] Task completed $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "[SESSION] Fin de session $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "[COMPACT] Compaction du contexte $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "[COMPACT] Post-compaction $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true'

InstructionsLoaded.description: Logger le chargement des instructions (CLAUDE.md et rules)

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "[INIT] Instructions loaded $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-sessions.log 2>/dev/null || true'

Elicitation.description: Logger les demandes d'input MCP Elicitation

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "[MCP] Elicitation request $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-mcp.log 2>/dev/null || true'
bash -c 'echo "[MCP] Elicitation result $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" >> /tmp/claude-mcp.log 2>/dev/null || true'
